lines.zh: 我一步一步地踩着落叶。
lines.en: I tread on fallen needles.

lines.zh: 我的身体很沉，走得很稳。
lines.en: I'm heavy, and I walk steadily.
I cross the pine forest.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲边缘擦着树枝。
lines.en: My armor's edge scrapes branches.
I step around a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在苔上没声音。
lines.en: My steps make no sound on moss.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近慢慢地巡。
lines.en: I patrol slowly near my anchor.
I walk with my head lowered.
The thing on my back rattles.
I walk a few steps and stop.
I turn and take another direction.
I push through low scrub.
I stand like an iron statue.
I'm honing my blade.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，盔甲边擦着树枝。
lines.en: I step through leaves, armor edges brushing branches.

lines.zh: 我把背上的东西放下来。
lines.en: I set down what I carry.
I listen to the forest.
One of my joints turns a notch.
I wait for the one who tamed me.

lines.zh: 只有松果落在我的铁甲上。
lines.en: Only pine cones fall on my iron armor.
I plant my blade in the soil.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼出一口白气。
lines.en: I let out a slow white breath.
I count the cones on the trees.
My foot is bigger than a face.
I lean on my blade, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 我把重量挪到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg.
You look small at my feet.

lines.zh: 我低下头，头盔发出响声。
lines.en: I lower my head and my helmet rings.
Are you walking with me?
My blade is only for guarding.
What's in your hand?
I smell pine resin on you.
I turn, and my armor clanks.
You're a head shorter than me.

lines.zh: 这一片松林由我的刀守着。
lines.en: My blade keeps watch over this pine stand.
Step back and I'll lower my head.
I've heard the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 绕到我看得见的地方来。
lines.en: Come round where I can see you.
I put my blade away.
If you're tired, lean on a tree.
I can carry, and I can fight.
Let's walk a stretch together.
A dent in my armor.
Half a step back, then steady again.
A gear clanks inside.
That turned me half about.
Sand is in my gears; they grind.
I switch the blade to my other hand.
I stand with my head low, breathing.
My armor hasn't broken yet.

lines.zh: 你的落点比我判断的准。
lines.en: You land your hits truer than I judged.
I need to fall back a way.
That thing could be carried.
You set that thing down.
I go over with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 我背上这把电锯，一直在转。
lines.en: The saw on my back never stops.
I reach out an armored hand.
No need for you to lift it.
I can carry it back.
Bombs hang all over me.
I hoist it onto my shoulder; my armor creaks.

lines.zh: 你带路，铁甲在后面跟着。
lines.en: Lead on; the iron armor follows behind.
I can take another.

lines.zh: 戴上铁甲的手，先搬这个。
lines.en: My iron-clad hand moves this first.
You hit me like an iron post.
I step back and my armor clanks.
I put my arm across your path.
Don't push; I won't move.
We collide and you give way.

lines.zh: 我的铁脚背，踩了也不晃。
lines.en: My iron instep doesn't shift underfoot.

lines.zh: 我把手横在你前面，别推。
lines.en: I put my hand across your way — do not push.
That didn't shift me.
I steady you.
I step away slowly.
Another steps from behind the trees.
Our armor clangs.
It's taller, with a longer weapon.
We guard this forest together.
It sits with its blade across its knee.

lines.zh: 我们的节奏慢慢对上了。
lines.en: Our rhythms slowly match.
It wipes my pauldron.
Two of us, and the road is clear.
I understood what it said.
We take turns patrolling here.

lines.zh: 我用铁手抓起一块木头。
lines.en: My iron hand grips a log.
I'll carry this back.
I bend, lift it, and set it on my left shoulder.
I haul this along the ground.
I set it by my anchor.
One in each hand.
I turn the log over and read its rings.
This can mend my armor.
I stow it in the scabbard.
I'll look after it.
You've moved what I guard.
I lower my blade.
My plates lock down all at once.
I keep these woods.
If you'd withdraw, do it now.
I stamp one step forward.

lines.zh: 我这颗炸弹，笑起来很圆。
lines.en: This bomb of mine has a round grin.
I've noted you down.
My blade points down.
I stride out, armor ringing.
World Slash, and the blade turns.
My iron body has gone cold.
I close in inch by inch.
You run circles; I don't chase.
I turn broadside and block the way.
I'm gauging how many feet away you are.
My blade is at my shoulder line.
Your back is to the pine. Nowhere left to go.
Tree shadow won't hide you from me.

lines.zh: 我背上那圈刀片，一转身就割。
lines.en: The blades on my back cut when I turn.
I wait for your first move.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很稳，刀还没落下。
lines.en: My breathing is steady; the blade is not down.
Two more meters is enough.

lines.zh: 两格高的齿轮，站得很实。
lines.en: Two blocks of gears, planted firmly.
My blade sweeps across.

lines.zh: 钢珠一样的我，全身压上去。
lines.en: Like a steel ball, I put my whole weight in.
You block and give half a step.
My vambrace slams your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你听见铁碰铁的响声了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear iron on iron?
I pin you against the trunk.
I held three-tenths back on that cut.
You're still on your feet. Good.
I raise the blade and slowly lower it.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出一声闷响。
lines.en: One of my joints gives a dull knock.
Your arms are shaking.

lines.zh: 这里不是你能站的地方。
lines.en: This isn't where you should stand.

lines.zh: 松林里传来沉重的脚步。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps sound in the pines.
I step out from behind a pine.

lines.zh: 我的铁甲先反了一下光。
lines.en: My armor catches the light first.
This place needs a keeper.
I drive my blade into the ground.
I straighten up, taller than all around.
There's still gear on my back.
I shake the pine needles off.
I take my place by the anchor.

lines.zh: 松针上，我的眼亮起一道光。
lines.en: Among the pines, my eye throws one flare.
I raise my head and look around.
My feet settle on the ground.
Fire heats my armor until it's hot to touch.
I fall and snap branches.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，关节僵住了。
lines.en: Water floods my seams; my joints seize up.

lines.zh: 爆风推我退了两步，没倒。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back two steps; I stay up.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的胸甲上。
lines.en: Something strikes my breastplate.

lines.zh: 法术让我的动作慢下来。
lines.en: That spell slows my movements.
Without power I can't hold up.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的刀上，手一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my blade and numbs my hand.
The void grips my feet.
